description: The pivot table elucidates the number of scholarly articles published on the advancements in quantum entanglement communication technologies from 2020 to 2023. The data is categorized based on the primary source of research funding, distinguishing between Government grants, Private sector investments, and University endowments.

The pivot table illustrates the rate of glacial melt in meters per year across three major continents - North America, Europe, and Asia - from 2020 to 2024. The data suggests a gradual increase in glacial melt rate across all regions during this period, potentially influenced by rising global temperatures and increased environmental factors. The table provides a comparative view of how glacial melt varies geographically and temporally.
